prompt:
A high-fidelity visual design mockup of a MOBILE WEB PAGE, portrait phone viewport, full-bleed screen design. Flat screen design only: no phone hardware frame, no browser chrome, no hands, no device photograph. It is a birthday party invitation page designed as a seven-segment display panel.

STRUCTURE, top to bottom, as regions of a web page. No navigation bar. The whole screen is one matte near-black panel with a slightly textured non-reflective surface, laid out as a rigid grid of fixed display cells. Every glyph is built from the same eight-cell seven-segment mask, and the unlit segments are visible as faint dark ghost cells, designed as deliberately as the lit ones.

REGION 1, the top third: the digits 17:00 at enormous scale in bright LED red, four fixed digit slots with a colon cell between them, each digit made only of lit and unlit segments, a soft red bloom around the lit segments on the matte ground.

REGION 2, beneath it: the date 2026.08.28 in smaller amber seven-segment digits in fixed slots.

REGION 3, the centre: a single horizontal row of exactly FIVE identical square cells, evenly spaced, all precisely the same size, none emphasised. Each cell holds a small seven-segment figure. All five are lit at identical brightness.

REGION 4, beneath: the words HBD SUMMER PARTY rendered entirely in the same seven-segment alphabet, in amber, reading as a scoreboard caption row.

REGION 5, the bottom edge: a single quiet scoreboard row carrying Korean text 어반피크닉 워터파티룸 · 분당서현 in small dim amber dot-matrix characters.

PALETTE, strictly: matte near-black panel, bright LED red, amber, and faint dark ghost cells. No other colour, no gradients other than the LED bloom.

Rigid, mechanical, exact, nothing reflows or slides, everything sits in fixed cells. No people, no faces, no logos, no photographs, no prices, no invented text beyond what is specified.
